title: Bootstrap organization, repository and deterministic CI
body:
## Outcome
A contributor can open the dev container and run build, unit, conformance and replay checks from a clean clone.

## Exit criteria
- .NET and Python workspaces are reproducible
- PostgreSQL starts through Compose
- CI protects deterministic behavior
- Governance and issue forms are present

title: Define canonical ANECS contracts and invariants
body: Define Observation, Claim, EvidenceRelation, StateEstimate, Snapshot, SupplyProjection, DemandProjection, Gap, Readiness, DSU and ActionPackage with competency questions and negative fixtures.

title: Build the manufacturing identity and capability golden set
body: Create the governed 20–30 organization golden set with source manifests, identity labels, capability evidence, evaluator disagreement and adjudication records.

title: Implement B0 manual and B1 catalog baselines
body: Measure the current expert workflow and a conventional catalog/keyword workflow against frozen Needs, candidates and source snapshots.

title: Implement T1 semantic capability matching
body: Isolate the value of capability and requirement representation without evidence-state or DSU contributions.

title: Implement T2 identity-safe temporal evidence state
body: Add identity resolution, provenance, valid/acquisition time, conflict visibility and sealed snapshots while preserving the T1 candidate universe.

title: Implement T3 Decision Sensitive Unknown and P0 action policy
body: Derive blockers and readiness, classify decision-sensitive unknowns and select the lowest-cost authorized action through deterministic policy P0.

title: Measure coordination utility and supplier burden
body: Compare decision quality, interactions, contacts, waiting time, human minutes, model cost and supplier response effort across B0/B1/T1/T2/T3/T4.

title: Produce sealed snapshot and deterministic replay packages
body: Reproduce gap, readiness, DSU, action and rationale from pinned ontology, policy, ruleset and source snapshot versions.

title: Run manufacturing-to-logistics ontology transfer stress test
body: Measure extension size, transfer effort and representational failure before adding any new core primitive.

title: Specify competency questions for the first vertical slice
body: Write competency questions for Observation → Claim → StateEstimate → Snapshot → DSU → Action and link every question to at least one positive and negative fixture.

title: Define canonical identifier and versioning rules
body: Define stable IDs, content-addressed IDs, ontology/policy versions and breaking-change behavior for replay compatibility.

title: Add identity merge guard fixtures
body: Add ExactIdentity, PossibleIdentity and false-merge fixtures showing that PossibleIdentity cannot aggregate canonical evidence.

title: Define frozen Need and candidate-universe manifest
body: Create a content-addressed manifest shared by every baseline and treatment condition.

title: Define coordination utility event schema
body: Capture search, contact, waiting, human, model and supplier-effort events with consistent units and attribution.

title: Decide code and specification licensing boundary
body: Choose whether code, schemas, documentation, fixtures and datasets use separate licenses before accepting external contributions or publishing releases.
